title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: How practice winds down
hook: Does your practice end with a cool-down?
intro: Kids grab their bat bags and run.
statement: A few calm minutes help bodies and minds wind down.
q1: Do you end every practice with a short cool-down —
q2: or use the time for one more game?
q3: What do you say during those last minutes?
t1: Both can work. But the end of practice is a good time
t2: to talk while kids are calm.
cta: Coaches — how do you end practice?
ctaLines: Stretch arms and talk. A walk. One more game.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Does your practice end with a cool-down?
The scrimmage ends. Kids grab their bat bags and run.
A few calm minutes help bodies and minds wind down.
A cool-down or one more game. Every team is different.
How do you end practice? Share your habit in the comments.
